requirements.description: Annual Compustat net income (NI), pretax income (PRETAX) and special items needed to construct PRESPC=pretax income minus special items, apply the common data-availability/zero/tail screens, form region-specific regressors, and retain undeflated Table 4 values.

required_coverage.frequency: annual firm-year observations (exact calendar/fiscal-year convention not stated)
required_coverage.population: All available Annual Industrial and Research Compustat firm-years in 1976–2001 after excluding financial institutions SIC 6000–6500 and utilities SIC 4400–5000; require nonmissing NI, PRETAX and PRESPC, then apply the paper’s yearly 1% tails/zero screens and Table 4 regression-level outlier deletion.
required_coverage.detail: The source gives the original year labels, three earnings measures, common-data screen, annual tails and zero exclusions. Table 4 reports 113,113 and 113,356 observations after an additional statistical-outlier deletion; that rule is not reported. Current COMP.FUNDA is the merged annual file and is not confirmed as the same product population/vintage as the article’s Annual Industrial and Research databases.

routes.mapping_notes: Current field labels semantically identify NI (ni), pretax income (pi) and special items (spi). PRESPC is computed as pi minus spi; this uses source definitions and labels rather than numerical resemblance to historical item IDs. Current COMP.FUNDA is a merged annual file, so historical product-specific sample membership is not established.

requirements.unresolved_reason: No coordinator coverage confirmation establishes the historical 1976–2001 records and exact product-specific population. The Table 4 statistical-outlier rule is unspecified, and panel sample sizes differ (113,113 vs 113,356) without a reported deletion criterion.

variable_coverage.construction: Use current-year annual net income (ni) as an undeflated Table 4 dependent variable; the fit sample is jointly screened on NI, PRETAX and PRESPC, annual scaled-distribution tails/zero values, and the reported but undefined Table 4 statistical-outlier rule.

Use undeflated current-year pretax income (pi) for observations whose pretax income divided by beginning-of-year market equity (Compustat item 25 × item 199) falls in region L (loss region left of small losses); the price/share observation date and boundary inclusivity are not specified.

Use undeflated current-year pretax income (pi) for observations whose pretax income divided by beginning-of-year market equity (Compustat item 25 × item 199) falls in region SL (six 0.005 intervals immediately below zero); the price/share observation date and boundary inclusivity are not specified.

Use undeflated current-year pretax income (pi) for observations whose pretax income divided by beginning-of-year market equity (Compustat item 25 × item 199) falls in region SP (six 0.005 intervals immediately above zero); the price/share observation date and boundary inclusivity are not specified.

Use undeflated current-year pretax income (pi) for observations whose pretax income divided by beginning-of-year market equity (Compustat item 25 × item 199) falls in region P (region right of small profits); the price/share observation date and boundary inclusivity are not specified.

Table 4 applies an additional statistical-outlier deletion but the source gives no criterion or reference population; reported panel sizes are 113,113 and 113,356 despite the common 114,177-observation base.
